fields.summary: Autonomous conductor plan, no owner present. Research found: the daemon's poll holds new starts and resumes on disk-low (rhiza.daemon.minFree, repo filesystem) and on load-high or memory-low (rhiza.daemon.maxLoad, rhiza.daemon.minMemory, internal/daemon/load.go Evaluate), saved in the daemon state file; rhiza run spawn (internal/api/run_spawn.go) already waits on the saved usage hold and machine hold (spawnHoldDetail in internal/api/usage_hold.go) and journals one spawn-held entry per wait, but not on disk-low; the run engine starts a workflow step's agent session (internal/run/engine.go agent, Runner.StartAgent) with no hold at all; no free-tmp check exists; the journal's SpawnHolds reach no inbox item. The plan adds a free-tmp hold to the daemon poll, makes rhiza run spawn and the engine's fresh step sessions wait on every saved pre-start hold, and shows a held spawn or step session in the inbox naming the reading and limit.
fields.title: Autonomous plan of the daemon's pre-start checks (m40 spawn holds)
